name: Djam tang soup
summary: A soup of djam tang, a fine-stemmed green from the banks of the Krông Ana, Krông Knô, and Serepok, cooked with stream fish. It tastes sweet from the green and nutty from the fish.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 24 Jun 2013 calls rau djam tang an Êđê forest specialty.
howToEat: Stream fish is the classic partner, though cooks also use paddy fish, măng le, mushrooms, or forest meat. The green sprouts in the rains.
seoTitle: Canh djam tang — river green and stream fish
seoDescription: Djam tang, a fine river green, cooked with stream fish into a sweet, nutty Ede soup.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 24 Jun 2013 says the soup is sweet from djam tang and nutty from the stream fish.
